domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Surface amendment 2 · #33154 · 2026-11-14T01:36Z

Amends claim 6868572380 and amendment 6868654518. Added to the file surface, test only: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts`, its `beforeAll` fixture. The fixture publishes a tenant extension validation `record.qx_credit > 5000000` on a nullable number through the real `object_extension` door. With this card the door judges extension validations with the object's own rule pass, whose null-guard gate refuses that condition, the same verdict the rule gets declared on the object. The fixture becomes `record.qx_credit != null && record.qx_credit > 5000000`, with a comment. ⛔ No production file is added.

This is a measured instance of the narrowing. The changeset's BREAKING banner and the semantic entry must name it: an extension validation that reads a nullable field without a null guard is now refused at the door and in the build, and the fix is the guard.
